topic_ko: 미술품 수집 행위에 담긴 미래 예측의 확신
_note: 빈칸(논설문) FULL set. 유형마다 passage를 다르게 paraphrase. grammar/vocab/blank의 밑줄·빈칸 어구는 해당 passage 문장에 글자 그대로 존재.

passage: Art values are inherently unstable, shifting not just in the marketplace but at a deeper level, and every serious collector is aware of this fact.
To buy a work of art is either to claim a place in art history or to acquire nothing beyond a personal keepsake.
When the collector signs the check, he is making a statement: he believes this work will stand as a turning point in the story of art.
Yet history offers no guarantees, and the worth of any chosen piece rests only on the fragile foundation of present opinion.
Such opinion has been overturned many times before and will almost surely be overturned again.
Ultimately, the act of purchasing a painting is a wholly personal decision, one that no expert or institution can make for the collector.
Through this act, the collector not only expresses his artistic taste but also asserts his belief that he can foresee the future direction of art.
choices: the role of institutions in shaping art market trends
why the act of collecting art reflects a personal belief about art's future direction
how art museums decide which works deserve permanent collection
the economic risks collectors face when investing in contemporary art
the difference between collecting art for pleasure and collecting for profit
theme.explanation_ko: 미술품 수집가는 단순 소유를 넘어 자신이 미술의 미래 방향을 예측할 수 있다는 개인적 확신을 담아 작품을 구매한다는 내용. ②가 주제이다.
theme.distractor_ko: ①기관의 역할, ③미술관의 수집 기준, ④경제적 위험, ⑤즐거움 vs 이익 구분은 본문 초점이 아니다.

passage: Art values constantly shift, and no collector can be certain that today's admired work will hold its place in the future.
Yet simply buying art for personal enjoyment reduces the purchase to no more than acquiring a souvenir.
A serious collector must go further, committing to the idea that the work occupies a meaningful point in art history.
This commitment necessarily involves risk, since present consensus can be displaced just as past ones were.
The collector should not be paralyzed by this uncertainty but should embrace it as the very nature of art.
In the end, purchasing a work is an act of courage — an assertion of one's own aesthetic vision.
The collector must be willing to affirm the conviction that he can predict where art is headed, despite all uncertainty.
choices: 수집가는 장기적 가치를 고려하기 전에 전문가의 조언을 먼저 구해야 한다.
예술 기관들은 시장 합의에 의존하지 않고 독립적 기준을 세워야 한다.
미술 수집가는 불확실성을 인정하면서도 미술의 방향을 예측할 수 있다는 확신을 가져야 한다.
미술품을 구매할 때는 개인적 즐거움보다 경제적 가치를 더 중요하게 고려해야 한다.
현재의 비평적 합의는 오래 지속되므로 수집가는 이를 신뢰해야 한다.
claim.explanation_ko: 불확실성에도 불구하고 수집가는 미술의 방향을 예측할 수 있다는 확신을 가지고 결단해야 한다는 주장. ③이 정답.
claim.distractor_ko: ①전문가 조언, ②기관 독립성, ④경제 우선은 본문 핵심이 아니고, ⑤는 본문(합의는 언제든 대체된다)과 정반대.

passage: Art values are by nature unstable, depending not only on markets but on something deeper and more elusive.
A collector who buys merely for personal taste acquires no more than a decorative object.
A true purchase is a declaration of belief that the work marks a significant point in art's overall progress.
That belief is fragile, however, since any present-day critical consensus is fated to be overturned eventually.
Recognizing this, the collector still acts, committing himself to a specific work through a personal decision.
The real courage lies not in choosing wisely but in asserting the conviction that one can read art's future.
Collecting, at its core, is an act of predicting where art is going.
choices: 미술 시장에서 수집가가 재정적 손실을 피하는 방법
비평가의 합의가 미술품 가격에 미치는 장기적 영향
미술 수집은 본질적으로 미술의 미래를 예측할 수 있다는 확신의 행위이다.
역사적으로 중요한 미술품은 시대의 합의와 무관하게 가치가 유지된다.
미술 기관들이 개인 수집가보다 더 정확하게 미술의 흐름을 예측할 수 있다.
gist.explanation_ko: 미술 수집은 단순 소유가 아니라 미술의 미래 방향을 예측할 수 있다는 확신의 개인적 행위라는 것이 요지. ③이 정답.
gist.distractor_ko: ①재정 손실 회피, ②가격 영향, ④가치 유지, ⑤기관 우위는 본문과 어긋난다.

passage: Art has never had a stable value; it shifts with culture, time, and collective taste.
For a collector, buying a work means either claiming a place in art history or settling for a fancy keepsake.
By signing the check, the collector publicly declares his faith in the work's enduring importance.
But that faith is built on sand: current critical opinion is destined to crumble as it always has.
Despite this, the act of collecting is inescapably the collector's own — no institution can bear it for him.
He goes ahead anyway, affirming both his taste and a bold conviction about art's trajectory.
In the end, the collector is betting not just on a painting but on his own ability to see art's future.
choices: How Art Institutions Shape the Future of Collecting
The Impossible Task of Agreeing on What Makes Art Valuable
Buying Art: A Courageous Bet on the Future of Art
Why Modern Collectors Prefer Investment Over Aesthetic Pleasure
The Art Market: History of Prices and Critical Consensus
title.explanation_ko: 미술 구매는 미술의 미래에 대한 용감한 확신의 행위라는 핵심을 압축한 ③이 제목으로 적절하다.
title.distractor_ko: ①기관의 역할, ②가치 합의의 어려움, ④투자 선호, ⑤가격·합의 역사는 본문 핵심과 다르다.

passage: The unstable and shifting nature of art values is always on the collector's mind, whether he buys personally or on behalf of an institution.
Acquiring a work means acquiring a piece of art history, or it means acquiring nothing beyond a personal souvenir.
By signing his check, the collector asserts his belief that the work will remain a significant point attained by art.
History remains open to revision, and the merit of any chosen work rests only on today's consensus.
Such consensus is all but certain to be displaced, as every previous consensus has been.
In the last analysis, committing himself to a painting is the collector's own act.
Through it he courageously affirms not only his aesthetic judgment but also the conviction that __________.

choices: he can predict where art is going
the artist behind the work is historically recognized
the work will immediately gain financial returns

blank.explanation_ko: 수집가는 수표 서명을 통해 자신의 미적 판단뿐 아니라 미술이 어디로 향하는지 예측할 수 있다는 확신도 확언한다. 앞 문장에서 '현재 합의는 대체될 것'이라는 불확실성을 인정하면서도 '자신의 행위'임을 말하므로, 빈칸에는 미래를 예측하는 개인적 확신이 들어가야 한다. ①이 정답.
blank.distractor_ko: ②작가의 역사적 인정, ③즉각 재정 이익, ④합의 안정성은 본문 논지와 충돌하고, ⑤미의 독립성은 글에 없는 개념이다.

passage: The dependent and shifting nature of art values, not only on the market but inherently, is uppermost in the mind of today's art collector.
Acquiring a work is acquiring a piece of art history, or it is acquiring nothing beyond an object of personal enjoyment in the same class as a cat or a souvenir.
In signing his check the collector asserts his belief in the future presence of the work as a significant point attained by art as a whole.
History, however, is open to anything and the merit of the chosen painting or sculpture has ―at best― only the validation of a present-day consensus.
This consensus is all but certain to be displaced, as others has been in the past.
In the last analysis, committing himself to a painting is the collector's own act.
Through it he courageously affirms not only his aesthetic judgment but the conviction that he can predict where art is going.

vocab.explanation_ko: ④ 본문 전체의 논지는 현재의 합의가 언젠가 '대체된다(displaced)'는 것이다. maintained(유지된다)는 이와 정반대 의미여서 문맥상 부적절하다 → displaced로 고쳐야 한다.
vocab.distractor_ko: ①shifting(변동하는), ②asserts(천명하다), ③validation(검증), ⑤conviction(확신)은 모두 문맥에 적절하다.

order.given: The dependent and shifting nature of art values, not only on the market but inherently, is uppermost in the mind of today's art collector, whether he buys for himself or as the representative of an institution.

blocks.A: History, however, is open to anything and the merit of the chosen painting or sculpture has only the validation of a present-day consensus, which is all but certain to be displaced as others have been in the past.
blocks.B: In the last analysis, committing himself to a painting is the collector's own act, through which he courageously affirms not only his aesthetic judgment but the conviction that he can predict where art is going.
blocks.C: Acquiring a work is acquiring a piece of art history, or it is acquiring nothing beyond personal enjoyment. By signing his check, the collector asserts his belief in the future presence of the work as a significant point attained by art as a whole.

order.explanation_ko: (C)에서 구매의 의미(미술사 참여)와 수집가의 믿음 천명을 제시하고, (A)에서 역사의 불확실성과 합의의 한계를 지적하며, (B)에서 그럼에도 수집이 수집가 자신의 행위이자 미래 예측의 확신임을 결론짓는다. (C)-(A)-(B).
order.distractor_ko: (A)의 'the merit of the chosen painting'은 (C)의 'acquiring a piece of art history'를 전제로 해야 하고, (B)의 'In the last analysis'는 (A)의 불확실성 논의 뒤에 결론으로 온다.

passage: Art values are inherently unstable and shift both in the market and at a deeper level.
Acquiring a work means either participating in art history or acquiring nothing beyond a personal object.
By signing his check, the collector asserts that the work will endure as a significant point in the story of art.
Yet history is open to anything, and the merit of a chosen work rests only on the present-day consensus.

In the last analysis, the decision to commit to a painting is the collector's own.
Through it he affirms both his taste and his conviction that he can predict the future course of art.
summary.summary_template: An art collector's purchase is ultimately a __(A)__ act in which he affirms his belief that he can predict art's future, even though the current __(B)__ on any work's value is bound to be replaced.
summary.explanation_ko: 수집 행위는 수집가 (A)개인의(personal) 행위이며, 현재의 비평적 (B)합의(consensus)는 언젠가 대체될 것이라는 내용. ①이 정답.
summary.distractor_ko: (A)는 financial/institutional이 아니라 personal, (B)는 price/market이 아니라 consensus여야 한다.

writing.question: 다음 우리말과 같은 뜻이 되도록 <보기>의 단어를 모두 배열하여 영작하시오.
writing.ko_prompt: 수표에 서명함으로써 수집가는 그 작품이 미술 전체가 도달한 중요한 지점으로서 미래에도 존재할 것이라는 믿음을 천명한다.
writing.answer: In signing his check the collector asserts his belief in the future presence of the work as a significant point attained by art as a whole.
writing.explanation_ko: In + 동명사(signing) '서명함으로써', asserts his belief in '~에 대한 믿음을 천명하다', 과거분사 attained가 point를 후치 수식.

writing.question: 다음 우리말과 같은 뜻이 되도록 <보기>의 단어를 모두 배열하여 영작하시오.
writing.ko_prompt: 최종적으로 분석해 보면, 한 회화에 자신을 헌신하는 것은 수집가 자신의 행위다.
writing.answer: In the last analysis, committing himself to a painting is the collector's own act.
writing.explanation_ko: 관용구 In the last analysis(최종적으로), 동명사 committing이 주어 역할.

writing.question: 다음 우리말을 <조건>에 맞게 영작하시오.
writing.ko_prompt: 그 합의는 과거에 다른 합의들이 그랬던 것처럼 거의 틀림없이 대체될 것이다.
conditions: as를 포함하는 비교 부사절을 사용할 것
writing.answer: This consensus is all but certain to be displaced, as others have been in the past.
writing.explanation_ko: all but(거의 ~인) + certain to be displaced(대체될 것이 확실), as others have been — 반복어(displaced) 생략.

writing.question: 다음 밑줄 친 문장을 우리말로 해석하시오.
writing.en_prompt: Through it he courageously affirms not only his aesthetic judgment, from whatever source it be derived, but the conviction that he can predict where art is going.
writing.answer: 그것을 통해 그는 자신의 미적 판단 ―그것이 어떤 출처에서 비롯되었든― 뿐만 아니라, 미술이 어디로 향하는지 예측할 수 있다는 확신도 용감하게 확언한다.
writing.explanation_ko: not only A but B(A뿐 아니라 B도), from whatever source it be derived(양보 부사절), the conviction that절(확신).

writing.question: 다음 글을 읽고, 요약문의 빈칸 (A), (B)에 들어갈 단어를 본문에 근거하여 쓰시오.
writing.summary: Buying a work of art is ultimately the collector's own (A)___________, through which he affirms the (B)___________ that he can predict where art is going.
writing.explanation_ko: (A) 수집가 자신의 '행위(act)'이고, (B) 미술의 방향을 예측할 수 있다는 '확신(conviction)'이다.

writing.context: History, however, is open to anything and the merit of the chosen painting or sculpture has ―at best― only the ___________ of a present-day consensus.
writing.explanation_ko: 선택된 작품의 가치는 '기껏해야' 현재 합의에 의한 '검증(validation)'만을 지닐 뿐이라는 내용. validate의 명사형.
